## Instructions
Arrange the symbols in the optimal order.

### System

The system relies on a unique set of four symbols, and it is only valid when all symbols are used exactly once. The order of symbols determines the system's performance.

### Symbols and Performance

| Symbol | Performance Rule |
| ------ | ---------------- |
| A | Best performance when not followed by more than one symbol. |
| B | Best performance when not preceded by symbol A or C. |
| C | Best performance when it is not the last symbol. |
| D | Best performance when it is the first symbol. |

The challenge is to arrange these symbols (A, B, C, D) in a sequence that maximizes their performance based on the given rules.

Based on the provided performance rules, the optimal arrangement of the symbols would be: D-B-A-C. This sequence allows each symbol to meet its best performance condition as follows:

1. D: It is the first symbol in the sequence.
2. B: It is not preceded by symbol A or C since there is no symbol before it.
3. A: It is not followed by more than one symbol (only followed by B).
4. C: It is not the last symbol in the sequence.

Based on the provided performance rules, the optimal order for the symbols (A, B, C, D) would be: D-B-A-C. This arrangement allows each symbol to meet its best performance condition as follows:

1. D: It is the first symbol in the sequence.
2. B: It is not preceded by symbol A or C since there is no symbol before it.
3. A: It is not followed by more than one symbol because there is only one symbol after it (C).
4. C: It is not the last symbol in the sequence.
